domain_title: Purpose, value, context, roles and classification
title: Risk, legal and regulatory classification
canonical_definition: The complete system and actual use are classified through a reviewable applicability analysis covering role, risk, jurisdiction, data, impact and sector obligations.

conditions: All AI systems; classification must be revisited after material change.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are applicable jurisdictions, roles, prohibited-practice screens, risk classes and adjacent legal regimes identified from actual use?
Are classification outcomes implemented as controls, documentation duties, review routes and transition constraints?
Is the rationale current, evidence-backed, independently reviewed where needed and linked to reclassification triggers?

conditions: Refer a material failure of risk, legal and regulatory classification to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.1 (PDF p. 27), MAP 1.1 (PDF p. 31), MAP 4.1 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on identifying applicable requirements and mapping legal risk in deployment context. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make risk, legal and regulatory classification verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: A4 evaluates risk, legal and regulatory classification using evidence from intent through operation. AP-A4 independently assesses evidence of superficial or static classification.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a system-level classification dossier linking operating facts to jurisdictions, value-chain roles, risk class, prohibited-practice screening and adjacent regimes. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates a trace from classification decisions to applicable obligations, control owners, required documentation and release gates. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides a current accountable legal review tracing disputed judgments to evidence and showing whether a material change triggered reevaluation. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in risk, legal and regulatory classification, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a system-level classification dossier linking operating facts to jurisdictions, value-chain roles, risk class, prohibited-practice screening and adjacent regimes. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate a trace from classification decisions to applicable obligations, control owners, required documentation and release gates. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide a current accountable legal review tracing disputed judgments to evidence and showing whether a material change triggered reevaluation. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how risk, legal and regulatory classification works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a system-level classification dossier linking operating facts to jurisdictions, value-chain roles, risk class, prohibited-practice screening and adjacent regimes. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use a current accountable legal review tracing disputed judgments to evidence and showing whether a material change triggered reevaluation to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A preliminary classification can be valid within its declared scope when unresolved questions visibly constrain progression.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-A4 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in risk, legal and regulatory classification
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in risk, legal and regulatory classification
Evidence remains insufficient for risk, legal and regulatory classification in the assessed scope
